narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__MF3ADC0D reveals an intermittent/lumpy demand pattern with high variability (CV=1.15). The analysis recommends increasing safety stock from 379 to 1658 units to achieve the 95.0% service level target. Order quantity is set at 4602 units (down from unconstrained EOQ of 6493 due to storage capacity constraints). The optimized policy is projected to save $1567.97 annually (31.3%) compared to the current SAP policy. Lead time analysis shows moderate variability, with demand_variability as the primary risk factor. Safety lead time should be increased from 4.0 to 4.9 days.
